answer: Lock work history for 30 days. Expire it if no fresh task lands. Idle accounts bleed standing each epoch. A history of 10 verified tasks is worth 10 times one task, and it cannot be transferred. The gale of signups has to keep blowing: 1,000 identities need 1,000 fresh tasks every epoch. A hollow record expires on schedule, and the yarrow of reputation grows only where work is renewed.
